name: io.github.gkanogiannis/gigwa-mcp
title: Gigwa-MCP
description: Drive a Gigwa genotyping server: import, server-side variant search, QC and diversity analyses.

environmentVariables.name: GIGWA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Gigwa server, without the /rest suffix.

environmentVariables.name: GIGWA_USER
environmentVariables.description: Username. Optional — omit together with GIGWA_PASS for anonymous (public/read-only) access.

environmentVariables.name: GIGWA_PASS
environmentVariables.description: Password. Optional — omit together with GIGWA_USER for anonymous (public/read-only) access.

environmentVariables.name: GIGWA_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: TCP connect timeout in seconds (fail fast on an unreachable server).
